verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's own site claims an ecosystem of 3,900+ providers and 23,600+ modules for managing infrastructure across every cloud platform. Its examples cover cloud and on-premises resources, DNS, and repository/team management. A community comment confirms it uses the upstream provider ecosystem, and its drop-in compatibility supports reuse of existing providers. Missing for 10: named first-party documentation of specific major cloud and SaaS providers (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP), provider registry documentation, and hands-on corroboration that the breadth claim holds.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage resources across all major clouds and SaaS providers through a broad provider ecosystem

citations.quote: With a thriving ecosystem of 3,900+ providers and 23,600+ modules, you can build and manage infrastructure across every cloud platform with confidence.
lets you define both cloud and on-premises resources in human-readable configuration files that you can version, reuse, and share
Create repositories, set up branch protection, and manage team access in code.
